_doc: One fixed English phrase per named point, used for every text-to-point model (MolmoPoint, Molmo2, Qwen3-VL, LocLLM, TAIHRI). Left/right are always the seated person's left/right. The template wraps the phrase.
template: Point to the {phrase} in this image.

furniture.desk_top_front_left: front left corner of the desk top (the corner nearest the seated person, on their left)
furniture.desk_top_front_right: front right corner of the desk top (the corner nearest the seated person, on their right)
furniture.desk_top_back_left: back left corner of the desk top (far from the person, on their left)
furniture.desk_top_back_right: back right corner of the desk top (far from the person, on their right)
furniture.desk_front_edge_center: middle of the front edge of the desk top
furniture.monitor_top_edge_center: middle of the top edge of the monitor
furniture.monitor_top_left: top left corner of the monitor
furniture.monitor_top_right: top right corner of the monitor
furniture.monitor_bottom_left: bottom left corner of the monitor
furniture.monitor_bottom_right: bottom right corner of the monitor
furniture.keyboard_near_edge_center: middle of the keyboard edge nearest the person
furniture.a4_front_left: front left corner of the white sheet of paper on the left side of the desk
furniture.a4_front_right: front right corner of the white sheet of paper on the left side of the desk
furniture.a4_back_left: back left corner of the white sheet of paper on the left side of the desk
furniture.a4_back_right: back right corner of the white sheet of paper on the left side of the desk
furniture.armrest_top_right: top of the chair's right armrest
furniture.chair_back_outer: rear-most point of the chair backrest
furniture.floor_under_seat: floor directly under the chair seat
furniture.wall_behind_point: wall or door behind the chair
